problem: Cut p95 latency on the /profile endpoint, currently 900 ms, mostly spent loading the user profile from Postgres
context: Single region, 3 app instances behind a load balancer. Redis is already deployed and used for sessions. Profiles change a few times a day per user. Users may see profile data up to 60 seconds stale.
constraints: Must not add new infrastructure components

options.summary: Cache serialized profiles in the existing Redis with a 60 s TTL, invalidated on profile update
Per-instance in-process LRU cache of profiles with a 60 s TTL
Deploy a Memcached cluster and cache profiles there with a 60 s TTL

criteria.description: Little new code and few moving parts to operate
All instances serve the same profile data after an update
